app.title: SAARTHI Access
app.tagline: Public Journey Accessibility & Evidence Freshness Platform
app.disclaimer: Decision support, not legal certification. Coverage depends on real-world audits and community reports. Unknown is never assumed accessible.
app.attribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) | Administrative data © Pune Municipal Corporation (OpenCity)

wheelchair.name: Wheelchair / Mobility
wheelchair.desc: Requires step-free entrances, ramps with slope ≤ 8%, lifts for multi-storey access, and door width ≥ 90 cm.

low_vision.name: Low Vision / Blind
low_vision.desc: Requires tactile guidance paving, audio signals at crossings, high contrast signage, and obstacle-free paths.

hearing.name: Hearing / Deaf
hearing.desc: Requires visual signage, text/digital counters, and non-audio announcements.

cognitive.name: Cognitive / Plain Language
cognitive.desc: Prefers short sentences, pictorial step-by-step navigation, and minimal sensory clutter.

elderly.name: Elderly / Senior Citizens
elderly.desc: Requires step-free access, frequent resting benches, handrails on stairs, and low exertion paths.

pregnant.name: Pregnant Women
pregnant.desc: Avoids steep stairways, requires lift access and accessible rest points.

low_stamina.name: Low Stamina / Fatigue
low_stamina.desc: Minimizes walking distances and avoids steep inclines.

caregiver.name: Caregiver / Companion
caregiver.desc: Configures dual access settings and enables shareable journey passport tracking.

verdict.unknown_notice: Unknown is never accessible. One or more critical steps have missing or expired evidence.

place.no_audits: No accessibility audits yet for this place. Status: Unknown.

profile.title: On-Device Access Profile
profile.subtitle: Stored strictly on your device (IndexedDB). Never sent to any server.

report.title: Report an Accessibility Issue
report.anonymous_notice: Your report is submitted anonymously. Photos will have all faces and vehicle registration plates blurred automatically on upload.
report.consent_checkbox: I consent to uploading this photo for accessibility verification and agree that detected faces and license plates will be permanently blurred.
report.description_prompt: Describe what you observed (e.g., broken lift, blocked ramp, raised kerb)
